label: Fixtures this matchday
description: Count of games in this Bundesliga round (same round_name season and league).

label: Home table rank
description: League table position for the home side before this matchday when standings exist.

label: Away table rank
description: League table position for the away side before this matchday when standings exist.

label: Home games in form window
description: Finished matches counted for the home team in the last five completed matchdays.

label: Away games in form window
description: Finished matches counted for the away team in the last five completed matchdays.

label: Home matchdays in window
description: Distinct completed rounds included for the home team (at most five).

label: Away matchdays in window
description: Distinct completed rounds included for the away team (at most five).

label: Home games with shot stats
description: Form-window games where shot statistics exist for the home team.

label: Away games with shot stats
description: Form-window games where shot statistics exist for the away team.

label: Home points in window
description: Sum of league points (3/1/0) over the home team form window.

label: Away points in window
description: Sum of league points over the away team form window.

label: Home points capture
description: Share of maximum points taken in the form window (points over 3 times games).

label: Away points capture
description: Share of maximum points taken in the form window for the away team.

label: Home goals per game
description: Goals scored per match in the form window for the home team.

label: Away goals per game
description: Goals scored per match in the form window for the away team.

label: Home conceded per game
description: Goals conceded per match in the form window for the home team.

label: Away conceded per game
description: Goals conceded per match in the form window for the away team.

label: Home shot share
description: Share of shots in the form window using ratio-of-sums across matches for the home team.

label: Away shot share
description: Share of shots in the form window using ratio-of-sums for the away team.

label: Home inside-box shot rate
description: Shots from inside the box divided by all shots in the form window for the home team.

label: Away inside-box shot rate
description: Shots from inside the box divided by all shots in the form window for the away team.

label: Home shot accuracy
description: Shots on target divided by all shots in the form window for the home team.

label: Away shot accuracy
description: Shots on target divided by all shots in the form window for the away team.

label: Home finishing efficiency
description: Goals divided by shots on target in the form window for the home team.

label: Away finishing efficiency
description: Goals divided by shots on target in the form window for the away team.

label: Home pass accuracy
description: Accurate passes divided by total passes in the form window for the home team.

label: Away pass accuracy
description: Accurate passes divided by total passes in the form window for the away team.

label: Home offensive link-up
description: Accurate passes divided by total shots in the form window for the home team.

label: Away offensive link-up
description: Accurate passes divided by total shots in the form window for the away team.

label: Home save rate
description: Saves divided by saves plus goals conceded in the form window for the home team.

label: Away save rate
description: Saves divided by saves plus goals conceded in the form window for the away team.
